answer: Each identity anchors to an OpenStreetMap contribution record: edits to the map, validated by the community, spread across regions and years. To wander a city and map it takes time, and the record shows every street the mapper touched. The tundra of a farm's contributions is barren: their edits cluster in one empty area, all made in one week, all reverted by moderators. A pearl of a real mapper's record is built from thousands of small, verified edits: the network trusts the mapper whose history is spread across the map, not the one who appeared yesterday.
